User Request: orders per month in 1997

Dashboard Components:
Title: Monthly Orders in 1997
Type: chart
Description: Trend of orders placed each month in 1997
Title: Top Products by Orders in 1997
Type: table
Description: Products with the highest number of orders in 1997
Title: Total Orders in 1997
Type: kpi
Description: Total number of orders placed in 1997

sql_queries.title: Monthly Orders in 1997
sql_queries.description: Trend of orders placed each month in 1997
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, COUNT(OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '1997' GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Top Products by Orders in 1997
sql_queries.description: Products with the highest number of orders in 1997
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, COUNT(od.OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM 'Order Details' od JOIN Orders o ON od.OrderID = o.OrderID JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y', o.OrderDate) = '1997' GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY OrderCount DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Total Orders in 1997
sql_queries.description: Total number of orders placed in 1997
sql_queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(OrderID) AS TotalOrders FROM Orders WHERE strftime('%Y', OrderDate) = '1997'
